maintenance_led.reason: Sells nutrition shakes, supplements and skin care consumables to consumers via independent distributors; not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from consumers and independent distributors buying nutrition and wellness products, not government payers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by selling its own Formula 1 shakes and supplements through its distributor network, not through regular acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Consumers can easily switch to other shakes and supplements; products are discretionary consumables with no qualification or regulatory switching cost.
